paragraphs.text: A lightweight, toggleable right-side notes panel for DeepSeek Harness.
# Side Memo
**Language:** **English** · 简体中文 · 繁體中文
A lightweight, toggleable **right-side notes panel** for DeepSeek Harness. Jot memos while you chat
— text, inline images, and labels — copy them with one click, star favorites to keep them pinned at
the top, and move everything in or out as an Excel workbook. When a conversation is worth keeping, o
ne click turns it into a memo.
**Category:** UI & Experience
## What it does

- **Quick notes:** Open notes beside your chat, or in a floating drawer before a Session starts.
- *
*Drag into chat:** Drag a memo from the list onto the chat box to paste its text into the message yo

u are writing.
- **Save a chat as a memo:** Click the chat-to-memo button in the conversation header
and pick **Save whole conversation** or **Save only my prompts** from the menu to copy the visible

conversation into a new memo and open it in the panel.
- **Save a single prompt:** Hover one of your
own messages and click the memo button that appears in its action row beside **copy** to save just

that prompt as a new memo, without opening the header menu.
- **Stay organized:** Search notes, add

labels, filter or group by label, and pin favorites.
- **Add images:** Paste or drag images into not

es, or use the image button.
- **Resize images:** Select an inline image for a Photoshop-style trans

form box, then drag a handle, nudge with the arrow keys, or reset it to its original size.
- **Copy

and transfer:** Copy notes in one click; import or export notes as Excel workbooks.
- **Right-click
actions:** Right-click a memo — or press `Shift`+`F10` — for Open, Copy, Duplicate, favorite and Del

ete, without leaving the list. Delete asks for a second click, like the editor.
- **Save locally:**

Notes and images stay in your browser and are available across Sessions.
- **Stays fast:** image dat
a is read only when the notes panel or the pre-Session drawer first opens, never at plugin startup,
and off-screen memo rows skip layout and paint when the chat column resizes. A 300-memo library stay
s responsive even with tens of megabytes of images.
## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** (developed and tested against **0.2.1-rc.3**, Desktop profile).
- Web G
UI and Desktop (Electron/Chromium). The client half relies on standard browser APIs: `localStorage`,
IndexedDB, Clipboard, File API, `Blob`/`URL`, Canvas, and `DecompressionStream('deflate-raw')` for

reading compressed `.xlsx` files.
- Uses the shipped right-sidebar plugin API (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-cli
ent-ui-sidebar-right`); the panel is a normal right-sidebar tab, so a Session is required to host it
. Before any Session exists the same notes UI is rendered by the plugin itself in the frame-level ov
erlay layer (`shell.overlay`). In the pre-Session and new-Session phases the toggle mounts through t
he resident header's `conversation.header.leading` seat and positions itself at the header's right e

dge from the live header/panel-toggle geometry.
- Uses the conversation client's composer insertion

API (`inputActions`) to paste a dragged memo into the chat draft as a single undoable edit.
- Uses t
he chat client's standard `useChat` hook (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat`) to read the visible con
versation transcript. The chat-to-memo entry is registered in the session-scoped `conversation.sessi
on.header.utilities` slot next to the Side Memo toggle; like the rest of the header, it is not shown

on a blank new Session.
- TypeScript sources live under `src/`; `client.js` and `index.js` are the
compiled browser and Host modules committed to the repository, so installing or running the plugin n
ever needs a build step.
## Permissions & privacy

- **No network access** and no external services.
- **No Host data access** and no agent-facing tool

s. The Host half is an empty `apply()`.
- Memos and images stay in this browser (`localStorage` for
notes, under the `dsh.side-memo.notes.v1` key; IndexedDB for image data, under the `dsh-side-memo-im

ages` database); they are not encrypted or synced across devices.
- Clipboard writes happen only whe

n you click copy.
- Excel files are read from and written to your machine through the browser's file
picker/download — they are never uploaded.
## Known limitations

- Browser-local storage only: no cross-device or cross-browser sync.
- Without a Session the notes o
pen in the plugin's own floating drawer (the right sidebar itself is Session-scoped); the drawer and

the right-sidebar tab are alternative hosts for the same notes.
- Drag-to-compose needs an open Ses
sion with an editable chat box and pastes plain text only: memo images and labels are not transferre

d.
- Chat-to-memo captures plain text only: the visible user prompts and the assistant's text replie
s (or, when you pick the prompts-only entry, only what you sent). Reasoning, tool output and images
are not included, the 8,000-character body limit drops the oldest turns first, and the memo title is
taken from the first prompt (with a generic fallback title when there is none). The button in a mes
sage's action row saves only that one prompt's text; it appears for user messages whose visible text

is non-empty.
- Text is plain text (no Markdown or rich-text formatting); images are the only rich
content. Images are downscaled before storage and are not exported to Excel — the `Images` column on

ly holds a count.
- Image support needs IndexedDB and Canvas. If the browser blocks IndexedDB, the t

ext memos keep working and image insertion is disabled.
- Images are loaded the first time the notes
panel or the pre-Session drawer opens in a page load. The text list appears immediately, and a very
large image library can take a moment before images — and the editor's image controls — are ready.
- Excel import reads the first worksheet only; formulas import as their cached values, and rich-text

cell formatting is ignored.
- Limits: 300 memos, 120-character titles, 8,000-character bodies, 12 l
abels per memo (24 characters each), 20 images per memo (source images up to 24 MB, downscaled to at
most 1,400 px at quality 0.82 before storage; display sizes 24–1,400 px), 8 MB `.xlsx` imports (up

to 32 MB expanded across at most 64 entries), and a 60 MB total image budget for the browser.
